name: Domon Kamado
source:
Servant.

Loyal to the Kukuri family, virtuous, and selfless. A devoted follower of the Shuten Order. He was hired to handle household tasks and is treated like a workhorse by the family. Naturally, he has no right to inherit. He can't understand at all why there's such tension over the inheritance.

[From in-game suspect profile]
